description:
Returns a single project-level aggregate balance across all funding sources entitled to the specified project that match the requested status. Defaults to active funding sources when the status filter is omitted.
Requires the `view_funding_sources_for_project` granular permission on the Prime Contract tool.

parameters.name: filters[status][]
parameters.description: Filter by status. Prefer the repeatable array form, e.g. `filters[status][]=ACTIVE&filters[status][]=INACTIVE`. A single scalar value (`filters[status]=ACTIVE`) is also accepted for backwards compa...

data.description: Aggregated project-scoped balances across entitled funding sources matching the status filter. Amounts are returned with exactly 2 fractional digits.

currency_iso_code.description: Currency shared by the aggregated project balances.

allocated.description: Sum of amounts assigned to this project from matching funding sources.

appropriated.description: Sum of amounts approved across prime contracts on this project.

available_to_appropriate.description: Funding available for prime contracts on this project. Equal to allocated minus appropriated.

committed.description: Sum of amounts approved across subcontracts, purchase orders, and change orders on this project.

uncommitted.description: Allocated funds on this project not yet committed. Equal to allocated minus committed.

uncommitted_appropriation.description: Appropriated funds on this project not yet awarded to subcontracts or vendors. Equal to appropriated minus committed.

available_to_commit.description: Remaining funds on this project available for new subcontracts and vendor commitments. Equal to allocated minus committed.

spent.description: Total of approved commitment invoices and direct costs billed against matching funding sources on this project. Equal to spent_via_commitment plus spent_via_direct_cost.

spent_via_commitment.description: Amount billed on this project through approved commitment invoices.

spent_via_direct_cost.description: Amount billed on this project through approved direct costs.

available_to_spend.description: Remaining allocated funds on this project not yet spent through commitment invoices or direct costs. Equal to allocated minus spent.

unspent_commitment.description: Portion of committed funds on this project not yet billed through commitment invoices. Equal to committed minus spent_via_commitment. Direct-cost spend does not reduce this value.

drawn.description: Total billed on this project through approved upstream invoices.

available_to_draw.description: Remaining allocated funds on this project not yet billed through approved upstream invoices. Equal to allocated minus drawn.

undrawn_appropriation.description: Portion of appropriated funds on this project not yet billed through approved upstream invoices. Equal to appropriated minus drawn. Can be negative.

as_of.description: When the balances snapshot was taken. Null when a snapshot time is not available; do not treat these amounts as live if this is null.
